headline: Payment Fees on $100 Invoices Compared
description: Side-by-side fees and net on a $100 freelance invoice across Stripe, PayPal, Square, Venmo, Cash App, and Shopify — plus reverse pricing to net $100.

mainEntity.name: How much is Stripe’s fee on $100?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stripe’s common US online card rate is 2.9% + $0.30, so the fee is $3.20 and you keep $96.80. Charge about $103.30 if you need $100 net.

mainEntity.name: How much does PayPal take on a $100 Goods & Services payment?

acceptedAnswer.text: US Send/Receive Money for Goods & Services is 2.99% with no fixed fee → $2.99 fee, $97.01 net. Do not confuse that with PayPal Checkout at 3.49% + $0.49 (~$3.98 on $100).

mainEntity.name: Is Square more expensive than Stripe on $100 online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Square Free-plan online/invoice pricing at 3.3% + $0.30 is $3.60 on $100. Square Plus/API online at 2.9% + $0.30 matches Stripe’s common US card rate dollar-for-dollar on this amount.
